scope: One separately authorized exact AdaptiveAvgPool2d export-compatibility follow-up; preserve the completed earlier research and its rejection.

globalGraph.padding: Preserve upstream safe_forward padding and returned source extent; do not truncate perimeter labels.

localGraph.policy: Preserve upstream local iteration, padding, thresholds and compositing.

lowering.overlap: Preserve upstream overlapping windows for non-divisible extents; never substitute fixed non-overlapping pooling.
lowering.graphRewriteLimit: Only the selected exact pooling lowering; no architectural, learned-weight, activation or interpolation changes.

numerical.reference: Independent PyTorch AdaptiveAvgPool2d FP32 outputs on synthetic feature tensors; retain generator, environment, shapes, bytes and hashes.

runtime.cpuAllowance: Synthetic pooling references and export tracing only; no CPU photographic inference or inference fallback.
runtime.gpuFailure: Preserve the actual reason; stop without equivalent CPU restart.
runtime.cancellation: No output publication; drain owned GPU/process resources.

sentinels.focus: Fence-only coverage must exclude gaps, tree trunks, foliage and ground.
Retain both narrow legs, feet and leg rings; exclude neighboring bird and ground.
Retain the robin and beak; explicitly exclude the held mealworm.
Retain hair-like flyaways and curls; avoid background spill. Historical wig is not human-portrait hair.

photographicGate.continueToTwelveScenesOnlyIf: All four hard cases show useful quality without material regression, excluded-object contamination or unusable semantic coverage.
photographicGate.fullPhotographicOrchestration: Build only after pooling and both model technical gates pass and the remaining integration is bounded; stop before substantial new infrastructure or any math change.
photographicGate.broadAdoptionGate: All twelve scenes usable, no regressions, and gains for fur, hair-like, feather, foliage and hard-edge classes; prior scope unchanged.
